name: pricelogic
description: PriceLogic — Shopify bulk pricing and supplier-sheet app.

comments.no-workspaces: backend, frontend and packages/shared install independently, each with its own lockfile. npm workspaces would give a single root lockfile, but converting requires re-resolving typeorm's ~30 optional peer drivers from scratch, which this machine does not have the memory to complete. The apps depend on the shared package through 'file:../packages/shared', which npm symlinks — the developer experience is the same.
comments.build-order: packages/shared must be built before the apps typecheck or test; they consume its dist/, not its src/.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/shared install && npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix packages/shared test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
